tasks.title: Q6 · Simple interest
tasks.prompt: Write a PL/SQL function to find simple interest.

tasks.title: Q8 · Factorial

tasks.title: Q21 · PKG_PROJECT_MGMT package
tasks.prompt:
Create a package and package body named PKG_PROJECT_MGMT containing:
• Procedure ADD_PROJECT to insert a project into PROJECT.
• Procedure ASSIGN_EMPLOYEE to assign an employee to a project (insert into PROJEMP).

The package must also include an exception that handles duplicate project numbers.

tasks.title: Q22 · PKG_REPORTS package
tasks.prompt:
Create a package PKG_REPORTS with:
• Function GET_PROJECT_BUDGET(p_proj_no) that returns TOT_AMT for a given project.
• Procedure LIST_PROJECT_EMPLOYEES(p_proj_no) that displays employee names working on that project.

Use a cursor inside the procedure.

tasks.title: Q23 · PKG_EMP_MGMT package
tasks.prompt:
Create a package PKG_EMP_MGMT that includes:
• A record type based on EMPLOYEE20 table.
• Procedure SHOW_EMPLOYEE(p_emp_no) that prints employee name, salary, and department.
• Procedure UPDATE_SALARY(p_emp_no, p_increment) that increases salary.

Handle the exception if the employee does not exist.

tasks.title: Q24 · proj_mgmt_pkg package
tasks.prompt:
Create a package named proj_mgmt_pkg that includes:
(a) Function get_project_title(PROJ_NO).
(b) Function get_employee_salary(EMP_NO).
(c) Procedure add_project(PROJ_NO, PROJ_TITLE, SPON_BY, START_AT, DURATION, TOT_AMT).
(d) Procedure assign_employee_to_project(EMP_NO, PROJ_NO).

tasks.title: Q25 · Validate project amount and duration
tasks.prompt: Create a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger on PROJECT to ensure TOT_AMT > 0 and DURATION is not negative. If a value is invalid, raise an application error.

tasks.title: Q26 · PROJECT audit trigger
tasks.prompt: Create an AFTER UPDATE FOR EACH ROW trigger on PROJECT that stores the update date into a PROJECT_AUDIT table.

tasks.title: Q27 · Block weekend employee operations
tasks.prompt: Create a BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE trigger on EMPLOYEE that prevents all operations on Saturday and Sunday.

tasks.title: Q28 · Confirm project assignment
tasks.prompt: Create an AFTER INSERT trigger on PROJEMP that displays the message: 'Employee assigned to project successfully.'

tasks.title: Q29 · Transaction-control exercise
tasks.prompt: Write a PL/SQL block using the transaction-control (TCL) commands while inserting values into EMPLOYEE: BEGIN TRANSACTION, SAVEPOINT A, UPDATE EMPLOYEE, SAVEPOINT B, ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT A, COMMIT.
